jobs.text: In 1905 the British Viceroy, Lord Curzon, divided the huge province of Bengal, creating a new province of East Bengal and Assam with Dhaka as its capital. Many Muslims in the east welcomed the chance of new schools and jobs, while many Hindu leaders in Calcutta protested, launching the Swadeshi movement and boycotting British goods. In 1911 the division was cancelled.
